# Code of conduct

hermretro follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be kind and patient, assume good intent, criticise work rather than people, and welcome newcomers
(many people here are making their first game). Harassment, insults, sexualised language or imagery, and
publishing someone's private information are not accepted in issues, pull requests, discussions or anywhere
else this project is represented.

## Reporting

Report behaviour that breaks these rules privately to the maintainer (@ThePickle31): use GitHub's
**Report content** option on the comment, issue or pull request, which reaches the maintainer and GitHub. Reports
are kept confidential. The maintainer may edit or remove contributions, and warn, or temporarily or permanently
block, anyone who breaks these rules, following the Covenant's enforcement guidelines.
